title: [clinic · EX-03] Break the funnel on purpose
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-03` — Break the funnel on purpose](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-03-break-the-funnel-on-purpose.md) · difficulty 🔴

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Breaking it so thoroughly that every metric goes to zero. A funnel break that kills everything teaches nothing — you want the stage-specific signature.

**2.** Breaking retrieval and then reading only the answer metric, which moves for every kind of break.

**3.** Forgetting to restore state between breaks, so break three is measured on top of break two.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-03]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
